comments.body: Since helpers close with their maker once idle (94edf9e8), the closed-maker banner only appears for helpers still at work. A click doing pane show --helpers-of would now also keep them open, which this card should account for.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-7 section 6 (docs/mip/0007-helpers.md) has a click on the notice that a helper's maker closed bring the helpers forward, as Show Helpers does. Stage 2 (2026-10-17) made the banner show the notice's own words, which end `muster pane show --helpers-of <maker id>`, but a click still opens the transcript.

Why it was left: to know which maker a banner is about, the message has to carry the maker - a new field on a saved transcript entry (`What::Message` in crates/muster-msg/src/entry.rs), the same field on the wire that copies entries between machines, and again on the notice, the core's attention state and the banner's userInfo.
title: A click on a closed-maker banner brings its helpers forward
